summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a notice from GQG Partners LLC that it holds 5.02% of the company's common shares and ADRs as a passive minority investment. GQG explicitly states it does not intend to alter control or management. This is a routine ownership disclosure under foreign private issuer reporting rules; it does not represent a special situation such as an activist campaign, strategic review, or other event-driven category.
